title: Stained my Italian leather couch
text: Stained my Italian leather couch. I did not wash this product before using it. I don't remember any warnings to do do. I put it on used it for a couple of days, then when my dog got it dirty, I took it off to wash it. I noticed it left blue stripes and marks on my couch. I have not been able to get them off yet.
